tests_run.outcome: both findings below reproduced; no MLX/Torch import (asserted)

checked_ok: Calibration: exactly the ordered C76 rows (28 sequence/48 correspondence) bound by id, canonical row hash, image sha, rendered-prompt hash and native input-token ids; K4/max256/seed7/temperature1 fixed; token cap 4*25404+76*4*256=179440 enforced; common-B28 weights anchored by a 504-tensor fingerprint, optimizer step must stay 0, no path to optimizer.update.

Calibration resume: row-atomic journal (receipt hash chain, immutable per-row RNG/Adam snapshot via load_optimizer_checkpoint, initial_state snapshot before row 0); restore loads the snapshot of the last COMPLETED row so a retried row replays the same RNG stream; completed rows are never regenerated; the log is reconciled to the journal.

Unfinished work: each attempt has a durable reservation (binding, parent receipt, row, reserved_cost); abandoned directories are charged once as measured recorded prefix + imputed (missing responses x (L+256)), kept separate and immutable, and cannot be double-charged; a complete-but-unpublished raw group is charged as measured.

Statistics: per-prompt mean raw accuracy, numpy linear percentiles, explicit blocked=iqr<=0; calibration_for_arms raises on zero IQR (no floor); the bundle re-derives all statistics from the raw journal itself (cal._inspect) and then additionally requires a digest-bound independent proof; a blocked result emits no arm config.

Bundle: six calibrated scopes are built with the SAME tier_c_entry.prepare_arm as the raw arms (P/U x seeds 7/11/13), asserted to have byte-identical schedule ids to the corresponding raw arm, same plan/budget 169216/198/group4, same runtime block as the raw bundle; launch argv adds only --arm/--seed/--output/--calibration to the raw launcher; nothing is approved or launched.

SFT entry: ONE full frozen schedule/plan/run binding per seed; stage limit (max_new_steps), resume flag and output state are approval-scope fields only (run binding excludes them), so staged runs continue the same trajectory from the committed boundary with restored Adam moments, step and RNG (tests + shared restore); Tier B is fresh one-step only; Tier C additionally requires an SFT update receipt bound to the same plan AND current sources; GSPO dynamic proof must match the common start and cache.

SFT objective alignment (traced, unchanged kernel): first target token is predicted by logits position P-1 (P = expanded prompt length incl. visual tokens), loss averages exactly over len(target) positions; prompt token COUNT is checked against the frozen native measurement.

findings.severity: MEDIUM before any native SFT launch (not a calibration/GSPO issue)
findings.summary: The frozen plan stores sft.target_ids (tokenizer.json encoding of each approved target), but nothing at execution compares them with the ids the native step actually trains on. run_sft/NativeSFTBackend verify only the COUNT (t == target_tokens[id]).
findings.counterexample: results/claude_new_glue_repro_counterexamples.py: planned ids [7] vs native tokenizer ids [999], same length 1 -> sft_step trains on [999] and run_sft would accept (counts equal).
findings.affected: same-C-data SFT for all seeds if the native processor tokenizer ever differs from the hashed tokenizer.json encoding; low probability because tokenizer.json is hash-bound and the native tokenizer is the same file (a runtime check asserts the path), but the ids themselves are unchecked.
findings.minimal_fix: pass plan target_ids to the backend (e.g. backend.expected_target_ids like expected_images) and require native encode == planned ids before value_and_grad; add a regression with a different-id/same-length tokenizer.

findings.summary: Calibration resume is permanently blocked (ValueError: Pending calibration group has no reservation) if the process dies after mkdtemp(".pending-*") but before attempt_reservation.json is written; the directory is empty so no native work occurred.
findings.counterexample: same script: crash row 3, remove the reservation and contents of the pending directory, resume -> STUCK.
findings.affected: common-B28 calibration only; narrow crash window (microseconds); manual removal of an EMPTY pending directory would be required (not performed by code).
findings.minimal_fix: in _charge, treat a pending directory that contains no files at all as zero cost (reserved but never started) while still rejecting any directory with payload but no reservation; add the regression.

limits: Engineering/CPU source review only; no native execution, no MRI-derived number, no claim about visual understanding or patient generalization.

The calibration method is a MedGRPO-style binary mechanistic/null control as the code states; with K4 per-prompt means the support has at most 5 levels and may still be affine-equivalent to raw rewards (a scientific property, not a code defect).
Prompt binding in SFT is by token COUNT (calibration binds ids and rendered-prompt hash); acceptable but weaker.
I did not re-verify frozen experiment data, the 19 running-job critical sources, or resource policy.
Not independent of my own SFT kernel; Codex or another model family should review tier_c_sft.py core itself.
